description.en: The name of the account. You can call the [DescribeAccounts](~~DescribeAccounts~~) operation to obtain the name of the account.

description.zh:
账号权限，取值：
* RoleReadOnly：只读权限。
* RoleReadWrite：读写权限，默认值。
description.en:
The permissions of the account. Default value: RoleReadWrite. Valid values:

*   RoleReadOnly: The account has the read-only permissions.
*   RoleReadWrite: The account has the read and write permissions.
The ID of the instance to which the account belongs.

description.zh: 本参数仅用于内部维护使用，无需传入。
description.en: This parameter is used only for internal maintenance. You do not need to specify this parameter.

descriptions.en:
> 

*   Only Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instances of Redis 4.0 or later are supported.
*   The Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance must be in the running state.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore grant-account-privilege --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --account-name demoaccount --account-privilege RoleReadWrite --source-biz SDK --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun r-kvstore GrantAccountPrivilege --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000' --AccountPrivilege RoleReadWrite --SourceBiz SDK --AccountName demoaccount
